title: Watercolour washes
lede: Ten loose watercolour and ink washes, cut out of their paper as transparent PNGs, long side up to 1000px. The paint stays translucent, so each one takes the colour of its ground: use them on light grounds, where the pale areas stay quiet. PNG only.

elements.title: Red watercolour flower
elements.desc: A loose red bloom on a thin stem. The washes stay translucent, so it takes the colour of its ground.

elements.title: Green ink wash
elements.desc: Abstract olive and moss green washes with dark pooled edges. Runs off the top and left.

elements.title: Blue watercolour flowers
elements.desc: Two translucent blue blooms with dark centres and a scatter of ink dots.

elements.title: Blue ink wash
elements.desc: A deep blue ink bloom with lace-like edges. Runs off the top and left. Typography removed.

elements.title: Blue watercolour ring
elements.desc: A soft blue ring with a halo and brush marks inside, open in the centre.

elements.title: Watercolour figure, red
elements.desc: A loose figure in pink-red wash with white gaps where the paper shows.

elements.title: Watercolour figure, blue
elements.desc: The same figure with its colour shifted to blue.

elements.title: Red watercolour blooms
elements.desc: Three red blooms with thin stems and a few drops.

elements.title: Blue handprint
elements.desc: Five blue fingertips with a soft glow. Lettering removed.

elements.title: Green watercolour flower
elements.desc: A single green flower on a thin stem, in olive and moss washes with a touch of yellow. Signature and date removed.
